questions_and_answers.question_text: Which three kinds of expression can the shi...de construction focus on?
Write the Chinese question meaning "Where were you born?"
Write the Chinese for "I was born in Texas."
Which verb precedes the focused phrase in this construction?
Which marker follows the verb in this construction?
Besides time and manner, what does this note add to the list of focus points?
What is the Chinese for "to be born"?
Which preposition-like word introduces the place phrase in Wǒ shi zài Dézhōu shēngde?
Give the Chinese for "He came yesterday" using the shi...de construction.
Give the Chinese for "He came alone" using the shi...de construction.

articles.text:
1. A: Āndésēn Fūren, nǐ shi zài          Mrs. Anderson, where were you
      nǎr shēngde?                        born?
   B: Wǒ shi zài Dézhōu shēngde.          I was born in Texas.

Note on No. 1

The shi...de construction is used to focus on place expressions as well as on time and manner expressions.

Nǐ  | shi | zài nǎr    | shēngde?      (Where were you born?)
Wǒ  | shi | zài Dézhōu | shēngde.      (I was born in Texas.)
Tā  | shi | zuótian    | láide.        (He came yesterday.)
Tā  | shi | yíge rén   | láide.        (He came alone.)
